info.title: datastar
info.description: DataStar command line interface: builds deployment packages from source control, deploys them, and generates reversal scripts.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help information.

options.name: --command-name
options.description:
The command to execute (release | reversal |
inflate | merge | definitions | build) [defaults
to release]

options.name: --operation
options.description:
The definitions command's operation (list | prune
| share | inline) [defaults to list]

options.name: --category
options.description:
Limits the definitions command to one component
category [optional]

options.name: --database
options.description:
The target database (Oracle or Microsoft)
[required, except for inflate, which defaults to
the vendor each document was captured from]

options.name: --environment-name
options.description: The name of the database environment [required]

options.name: --connection-string
options.description:
The connection string to connect to the target
database [required]

options.name: --wallet-location
options.description:
The wallet location used for Oracle connections
[optional]

options.name: --audit-enabled
options.description: Enable writing details to the auditing tables

options.name: --audit-id
options.description: The audit id from the history table [optional]

options.name: --audit-history
options.description: The name of the audit history table [optional]

options.name: --audit-summary
options.description: The name of the audit summary table [optional]

options.name: --audit-reversal
options.description: The name of the audit reversal table [optional]

options.name: --audit-schema
options.description: The schema names for the audit tables [optional]

options.name: --audit-database
options.description:
The connected database for the audit tables
(SqlServer Only) [optional]

options.name: --audit-initialize
options.description: Create the audit tables if they don't exist

options.name: --license-key
options.description: The software license key [required]

options.name: --work-item
options.description: The work item or user story reference [required]

options.name: --version-number
options.description: The version number being released [required]

options.name: --artifact-name
options.description:
The artifact being deployed, when not specified
the work item and version is used [optional]

options.name: --reversal-id
options.description: The audit id of the changed being reversed

options.name: --reversal-enabled
options.description: Enable generation of the reversal scripts

options.name: --manifest.regexp
options.description: The regular expression for matching the manifests

options.name: --working-directory
options.description:
The directory path for the deployment packages or
manifests, or the data documents to inflate

options.name: --output-directory
options.description:
The output directory path for any outputs such as
reversal scripts or inflated scripts [optional]

options.name: --template-directory
options.description:
The template directory required for reversal
scripts [optional]

options.name: --statement-timeout
options.description:
The timeout in seconds to apply to the executing
statements [optional]

options.name: --rollback-transaction
options.description:
Rollback the deployment, this will still create an
audit record if audit is enabled [optional]

options.name: --default-schema
options.description:
The default schema for the deployment, this is
ignored if the templates contain a schema

options.name: --deploy-package
options.description:
The package to deploy if deploying from a nuget
package [optional]

options.name: --package-file
options.description:
The reversal package file for the output nuget
package.

options.name: --package-author
options.description: The reversal package author for the output nuget

options.name: --package-summary
options.description:
The reversal package description for the output
nuget package.

options.name: --package-id
options.description: The reversal package name for the output nuget

options.name: --package-version
options.description: The reversal package version for the output nuget

options.name: --package-directory
options.description:
The reversal package output directory for the
output nuget package.

options.name: --artifacts-directory
options.description:
Another name for --package-directory, as
GitSources.Tools called it. Note -ad is

options.name: --package-invariant
options.description:
Force a reversal package to be created even if no
changes are applied

options.name: --clean
options.description:
build: empty the output directory first; without
it, a directory that is not empty is refused

options.name: --include
options.description:
build: a file or folder to add to the package
root, as it is; give it once per path

options.name: --package-uri
options.description: The uri for publishing to the package repository.

options.name: --package-api-key
options.description:
The api key for publishing to the package
repository.

options.name: --package-header
options.description: The api key header for publishing to the package

options.name: --tns-admin
options.description:
This property specifies the Oracle tnsnames.ora
and/or sqlnet.ora directory location.

options.name: --log-level
options.description: The logging level.

options.name: --log-file
options.description: The log file to output as an artifact

options.name: --inverse-reversal
options.description:
The manifest for generated reversal scripts is
inverted [optional]

options.name: --merge-base
options.description:
For merge: the common base version of the data
document (git's %O)

options.name: --merge-ours
options.description:
For merge: the current version, which the merge is
written over (git's %A)

options.name: --merge-theirs
options.description: For merge: the other branch's version (git's %B)

options.name: --merge-path
options.description:
For merge: the file's path in the working tree
(git's %P) [optional]

options.name: --git-directory
options.description:
For build: the repository the artifacts are read
out of [defaults to the current directory]

options.name: --build-file
options.description:
For build: the deployment file to build, read from
disk, XML or JSON

options.name: --at
options.description:
For build: read every artifact and definition at
this revision instead of the version each item was
pinned at [optional]

options.name: --work-branch
options.description:
For build: a branch name to take the work item
from when none is given [optional]

options.name: --task-pattern
options.description:
For build: the pattern that finds the work item in
a branch name [optional, defaults to the built-in
patterns]
